overview.welcome.title: Welcome to Proxmox VE
overview.welcome.body: This short tour shows the most important parts of the web interface. You can stop at any time with Esc.
overview.tree.title: Resource tree
overview.tree.body: All nodes, virtual machines, containers and storages are listed here. Click an entry to manage it.
overview.search.title: Search
overview.search.body: Quickly find guests, nodes or storages by name, ID or tag.
overview.create.title: Create VM / CT
overview.create.body: Start the wizards for new virtual machines and LXC containers here.
overview.nav.title: Navigation
overview.nav.body: The menu changes with the selected entry: summary, options, backup, firewall and more.
overview.tasks.title: Tasks and log
overview.tasks.body: Running and finished tasks appear here. Open a task to see its full output.
lxc.welcome.title: Create an LXC container
lxc.welcome.body: The wizard has several steps. This tour covers the first one; you click through the rest yourself. Nothing is created until you confirm on the last tab.
lxc.tabs.title: Wizard steps
lxc.tabs.body: General, Template, Disks, CPU, Memory, Network, DNS and Confirm. Use Next and Back to move between them.
lxc.id.title: CT ID
lxc.id.body: A unique number for the container. Proxmox suggests the next free one.
lxc.hostname.title: Hostname
lxc.hostname.body: The name of the container inside your network.
lxc.unprivileged.title: Unprivileged container
lxc.unprivileged.body: Recommended: the container's root user is mapped to a harmless user on the host.
lxc.password.title: Root password
lxc.password.body: Set a password for root, or add an SSH public key instead.
lxc.next.title: Next
lxc.next.body: Continue with the template. On the last tab, Finish creates the container.
snap.intro.title: Snapshots
snap.intro.body: A snapshot saves the current state of this guest so you can return to it later.
snap.take.title: Take Snapshot
snap.take.body: Give it a name and an optional description. Snapshots are fast but live on the same storage as the guest.
snap.rollback.title: Rollback
snap.rollback.body: Select a snapshot and roll back to it. Changes made after the snapshot are lost.
snap.remove.title: Remove
snap.remove.body: Delete a snapshot you no longer need to free up space.
bak.intro.title: Backups
bak.intro.body: Backups of this guest on your backup storages appear here. Unlike snapshots, they are separate copies.
bak.now.title: Backup now
bak.now.body: Create a backup right away: choose storage, mode and compression.
bak.restore.title: Restore
bak.restore.body: Restore the selected backup into this guest or as a new one.
bak.protect.title: Protection
bak.protect.body: Protected backups cannot be deleted by retention rules or by mistake.
lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.destructive: Warning: changes or deletes data. Only run it in your practice container.
lessons.hlMissing: The element is not visible right now. Open the matching view.
lessons.labHint: Use a dedicated practice container for the exercises.
arch.warn.title: Warning: wrong architecture
arch.warn.body: The template {template} is built for {templateArch}, your host uses {hostArch}. The container would fail with “Exec format error”. Pick a template for {hostArch}.
ext.invalidated: The extension was updated – please reload the page.
perm.title: Missing permissions
perm.intro: Your user is not allowed to run these requests, so the related checks do not work:
perm.item.expired: {endpoint}: not logged in. Session expired? Reload the page and log in again.
perm.tip: Tip: grant the role {role} on {tipPath} (Datacenter → Permissions → Add).
perm.limited: Without {privs} on {on}, {endpoint} only returns your own or visible entries. The check can therefore fail even though the action ran.
